dedupe_keys.name: acer data eu energy market monitoring reports dashboards and datasets eu agency for the cooperation of energy regulators

description: ACER, the EU Agency for the Cooperation of Energy Regulators, monitors EU energy markets with the Council of European Energy Regulators (CEER) and publishes the results as monitoring reports, infographics, Power BI dashboards and downloadable datasets. Its 2026 monitoring covers electricity and gas wholesale markets, LNG, decarbonisation of the gas sector, emerging hydrogen markets, security of electricity supply, electricity infrastructure and retail markets. Recent items on the data page include the EU CONE dataset of electricity investment parameters (July 2026), retail market dashboards, monitoring of projects of common and mutual interest, the EU electricity network tariff repository, Russian gas import contracts, and cross-zonal capacity and flexibility in Southeast Europe. ACER also monitors implementation of the network codes and the 70% cross-zonal capacity target. Coverage: EU member states. Format and access: web pages, dashboards and dataset downloads; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): ACER copyright notice: public documents may be reproduced with the source acknowledged; downloading licensed material beyond personal use needs permission. Caveats: the dashboards need analytics cookies to display, and individual datasets and their file formats were not opened. Simulation uses: investment cost parameters, network tariffs, cross-border capacity and infrastructure project status for capacity planning and energy security studies. Related records: the NESO data portal (data-neso-data-portal) is a national system operator counterpart for Great Britain.
